UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Stores a learner's cloud-synced Malayalam progress, XP, streak, and active session state for seamless handoff between Android and Laptop Web.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID matching the document ID.

completedQuizCount.description: Number of completed knowledge check drills.

spokenPhrasesCount.description: Number of completed speaking cadence exercises.

activeScreen.description: Last active screen (HOME, QUIZ, FLASHCARDS, AI_TUTOR, DIALECT_GUIDE) to resume session on laptop or phone.

activeDeckId.description: ID of the currently active flashcard deck.

activeCardIndex.description: Current card index within the active flashcard deck.

activeQuizIndex.description: Current question index within the active quiz session.

activeScenarioId.description: ID of the active AI Roleplay scenario.

lastDevice.description: Device that last updated the session (Android or Laptop Web).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LearnedPhrase.title: LearnedPhrase
LearnedPhrase.description: Individual Malayalam phrase mastered by the user.

phraseId.description: Phrase identifier matching the document ID.

manglish.description: Manglish transliteration of the learned phrase.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the phrase was first learned.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when mastery was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user cloud progress and active session continuity state.

/users/{userId}/learned_phrases/{phraseI.description: Subcollection of phrases mastered by the user.
